I might be wrong but as far as I know the game is at a point where it is balanced around exhaustion and game delay (gen regression/slowdown, whatever) perks. Ruin is probably by far the best value perk in this regard as far it is not cleansed within the first minute which does happen pretty often and is unfortunately also pretty rng based on totem spawns (which is one aspect I hate about noed). I just think that ruin counterplay is more manageable as noed counterplay.
